{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicates, keeping highest sample_seq per patient
data_clean = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the distribution of `arm` and `severity` to detect confounding
print("\nDistribution of arm:")
print(data_clean['arm'].value_counts())

print("\nDistribution of severity:")
print(data_clean['severity'].value_counts())

# Cross-tabulate arm vs severity to check confounding
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(data_clean['arm'], data_clean['severity']))"}
